summary: Iteration 59 covers avatar persistence on rider profile, self-serve DELETE /api/rider/account (GDPR cascade), Profile-vs-Settings rationalisation (Power Profile only on Profile), FTP removed from edit modal, and Settings subtitle update. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases pass (avatar round-trip, field regression, auth-guard 401 with and without invalid token, throwaway register->delete cascade with old token invalidation and login failure). Frontend (Expo web preview, mobile 390x844) after login as greenlantern: 20/20 UI checks pass — power-profile card + FTP stepper + tg-ftpAuto toggle present on Profile; delete-account button opens delete-account-modal with 'Delete forever' (confirm-delete) and 'Cancel' (cancel-delete); edit-profile-modal has NO input-ftp, and weight/age/gender/capability/city/region/country fields all present; Settings page has NO power-profile card and shows subtitle 'Coach, equipment and app preferences.'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >4700 lines — consider splitting into route modules (already noted in earlier iterations, still applies).
RiderProfileUpdate.avatar accepts an unbounded string; consider adding max-length/format validation to prevent oversized data-URIs from bloating the rider_profile document.
delete_rider_account has no additional confirmation token / rate limit — acceptable for GDPR self-serve but worth an audit log entry.
seed_data_creation: Throwaway rider test-del-<uuid>@roujaune-tests.app is created and then deleted within TestDeleteAccountCascade — leaves no residue. Greenlantern profile fields/avatar are restored to their original values at the end of each regression test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 59 features fully verified. If future iterations touch profile/avatar or account deletion, reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iter59_avatar_and_account_delete.py. Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Registration email validator rejects .test/.example TLDs — use a real-looking domain like *.app for throwaway accounts.
